description:
Use this tool when the user asks to see client reviews for a specific service provider (company).

It returns detailed reviews that include project information, pricing, scope, client feedback, ratings,
 and more.
Optionally filter reviews by a specific service. Use `offset`/`limit` for pagination; `has_more` says whether
another page follows.

company_name.description: The name of the company to get reviews for

limit.description: The maximum number of reviews to return

offset.description: The number of reviews to skip for pagination

service.description: The specific service to filter reviews by

name: get_service_provider_reviews

anyOf.description: A page of a provider's reviews for get_service_provider_reviews, saying whether more follow.

has_more.description: Whether more reviews follow this page. When true, call again with offset + limit.

items.description: Single provider review item with parsed project and narrative fields.

title: Get Service Provider's Reviews
